sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Throwables is a Combat skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: The throwing weapons handling skills allow you to throw grenades farther and with less energy consumption.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases throw strength (0.5% per level → +25% at Elite Level)
- Reduces required throw energy (1% per level → -50% at Elite Level)
- Increases throw speed
- Elite level: Throwables don't require energy and fatigue does not affect their accuracy

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Using Throwable weapons
- Completing the quest Consolation Prize
- Completing the quest The Huntsman Path - Control
